title.narrative: Accelerating Deployment and Adoption of Renewable Energy Technologies in Zambia

description.narrative: The project aims to enhance energy access and support the energy transition in Zambias Eastern Province by fostering the growth of inclusive clean energy enterprises. Currently, these enterprises are inadequate, underdeveloped, and often economically unsustainable. The project will prioritize the sustainable growth of viable energy enterprises, improving the accessibility, variety, quality, appropriateness, and cost efficiency of energy products and services in both rural and peri-urban areas.
